caseName: Houston v. Seaboard Air Line Railway Co.
caseNameFull: Georgia M. Houston, Administratrix, etc. v. Seaboard Air Line Railway Company
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of Appeals of the State of Virginia.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of. § 2.37 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6,1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726. Mr. R. Randolph Hicks for plaintiff in error. Mr. G. Hatton for defendant in error.
